## Objective
- Build a polished, playable Three.js first-person shooter in this repo from the user's one-word request "Game", using the environment's broader AAA FPS brief as product context.

## Requirements
- Browser FPS in Three.js, wave-survival, visually rich ("AAA quality" aspiration), playable on desktop and mobile.
- Support responsive layouts and touch controls (per project guidance).
- No external assets required; must run as static `index.html` via `start.sh`.

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained static game, no build step, using vendored Three.js r184 in `vendor/`.
- Wave-based arena survival titled **BLACKSITE // NIGHTFALL** with 3 enemy types (grunt/scout/heavy), synthesized WebAudio, full HUD, pickups, grenades, pause/game-over/menu.
- Added bloom via copied Three.js addons (`EffectComposer`, `RenderPass`, `UnrealBloomPass`, `OutputPass`) and tuned it down to strength `0.38`, radius `0.5`, threshold `0.92` after it washed out the scene.
- Player health set to 150 and enemy damage lowered for balance after dying too quickly.
- Added a tactical SpotLight on the camera to make enemies/scene readable in the dark.
- Menu background made semi-transparent and a tactical reticle added on the right for visual interest.

## Work State
### Completed
- `index.html`, `css/style.css`, `src/*.js` (main, world, textures, effects, audio, input, player, weapons, enemies, hud) implemented.
- Vendored Three.js and bloom addons under `vendor/`.
- Server running at `http://localhost:3002` (background shell, `PORT=3002 ... ./start.sh`).
- Playwright CLI works after symlinking `~/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1243 -> chromium-1248`; game renders with 0 console errors.
- Verified shooting/hits/kills/score/HUD killfeed, enemy spawning, weapon viewmodel, bloom, and menu screenshots.
- Fixed critical bugs: canvas passed as texture in pillar material, `this.sparks` shadowing `sparks()` method, enemies not becoming hittable after spawn, pointer-lock failure auto-pausing, audio mute state before init.
- Screenshots saved under `screenshots/` (`menu2.png` latest menu; `bloom-play.png`, `no-bloom-composer.png`, `fight.png`, etc.).

### Active
- Visual polish iteration after the latest menu reticle/background changes; just took `screenshots/menu2.png` but have not reviewed it yet.
- Need to re-test gameplay after latest bloom/balance/menu edits.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect `screenshots/menu2.png`; verify reticle does not overlap the side info panel at wide widths.
2. Reload, deploy, spawn enemies, and verify bloom is no longer washed out; screenshot gameplay.
3. Test reload (`R`), grenade (`G`), wave clear/intermission, pause/resume, and game over/restart flows.
4. Test mobile viewport/touch controls (390x844) via Playwright or `default-capture`; ensure pause button, joystick, fire, and rotate hint work.
5. Run the official capture flow (`capture.sh` with `CAPTURE_URL`/`CAPTURE_DIR`) to validate desktop and mobile screenshots and no page errors.
6. Check for console errors and performance; reduce maxAlive/enemy mesh count if needed.
7. Optionally add more environmental props/atmosphere and refine enemy silhouettes/weapon viewmodel.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: page structure, HUD, menu, pause/game-over, touch UI.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/css/style.css`: all visual styling, HUD, menus, responsive/touch.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js`: game bootstrap, state machine, waves, pickups, composer/bloom, scoring.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/weapons.js`: viewmodel, shooting/raycast, reload, grenades, recoil.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/enemies.js`: enemy models, AI, combat, spawn/death effects.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/world.js`: arena geometry, lighting, skyline, collision, LOS.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/player.js`: movement, collision, camera, health/regen.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/effects.js`: sparks, tracers, smoke, decals, shells, explosions.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/hud.js`: DOM HUD updates, banners, killfeed, hitmarkers.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/textures.js`: procedural canvas textures.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/audio.js`: synthesized WebAudio SFX/ambience.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/input.js`: keyboard/mouse/pointer-lock/touch input.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/vendor/`: Three.js and bloom addon modules.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/screenshots/`: verification images.

## Important Context
- Server is live on port 3002; use `export DISPLAY=:0` for `playwright-cli`.
- Chromium executable mismatch fixed by symlink `~/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1243 -> chromium-1248`.
- Playwright pointer lock succeeds in this environment; `input.hadLock` prevents auto-pause when lock is initially denied.
- Under SwiftShader the game runs slowly (~5–10 fps), and `dt` is capped at 0.05, so game time advances slower than wall time during tests.
- Useful test commands:
  - `playwright-cli click "#btn-deploy"`
  - `playwright-cli eval "() => { const g=window.game; ... }"`
  - `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/name.png`
- Gameplay test helper pattern: `g.enemies.clear(); g.player.pos.set(1,0,9); g.player.yaw=0; g.enemies.spawn('grunt', g.player.pos.clone().set(1,0,4.2), 1); e.fireTimer=999` to freeze enemy fire.
- All changes are uncommitted in the working tree.

I see the bug: enemies spawned with `spawning=true` for 0.45s. `hit()` returns false while spawning, but the grenade calls e.hit directly regardless. In our test we waited enough though (4s wall, >0.45 game). Hmm.

Actually the grenade explosion killed 0 because... wait, in the test, after throwing, `kills` was already 1 from prior test. So kills=1 could be from the grenade killing one. Before grenade test I did NOT reset stats. The kill test gave kills=1. Then we cleared enemies and spawned 3. After grenade, kills remained 1. So grenade killed 0.

Why? The grenade's explosion position maybe not near enemies. `throwGrenade` throws dir = camera direction. Player pitch 0, yaw 0 -> dir (0,0,-1), vel = (0,4.2,-15), from z=9. Time to land ~? starting y 1.7, gravity 20: y(t)=1.7+4.2t-10t^2, hits 0.11 at t≈0.75, z=9-11.25= -2.25! So grenade flies over enemies at z=4.5 and explodes at z≈-2.5 far behind them. Distance from enemy ~7, damage small (190*(1-7/7.5)=12.7). That explains no kills. Grenade throw is too strong/flat. In a real game, aiming down would help, but with default pitch 0, a grenade thrown forward travels 11m. That's arguably fine but could be improved: reduce forward velocity from 15 to ~11 and up from 4.2 to 3.2, making it land ~7m ahead. Also explosion radius 7.5 and damage 190 is quite strong.

Actually the bigger issue: grenades are thrown from camera position, and camera y=1.7, with pitch 0. Landing 11m ahead is realistic for a thrown object? An actual grenade throw at 15 m/s at slight upward angle travels far. But gameplay-wise, players expect to throw at crosshair; with aim down it works. Fine.

Still, I'd reduce speed a bit for usability. But not critical.
